text:
Sam (People Ops): Heads-up: we're updating the contractor background check policy in the handbook. New rules: standardized ID verification, role-based screening tiers (Tier 1: basic ID, Tier 2: criminal + reference, Tier 3: credit checks where permitted), and a required hiring-ops attestation. Draft here: https://handbook.internal.redwood/policies/contractor-screening-v1 :mag:

Jordan (Hiring Ops): Important: need a clear checklist for recruiters and a one-click export for hires that shows completed checks before contracts sign. Also need timeline SLAs (start background check within 48h of offer).

Marta (Legal): Country constraints: credit checks are not allowed in some EU countries; criminal record rules vary. We'll add jurisdiction callouts and a "legal-review-required" flag for Tier 3 in those locales. I'll provide a short list of restricted countries by EOD Wed.

Devon (Security): Can we add a security gate where access provisioning waits on screening status? Portal should set access_state=blocked until screening_status in (complete, cleared).

Sam (People Ops): Agreed. Planning to gate account provisioning for contractor identities. We'll add an export that includes screening_status, screening_tier, cleared_at, access_state. Example export/SQL below for Hiring Ops audits and SRE handoff:
```
# export contractor screening statuses
python tools/hr_exports.py --export contractor_screening --start 2026-07-01 --end 2026-07-31 --format csv > /tmp/contractor_screening_jul.csv

# BigQuery quick check
SELECT contractor_id, candidate_name, country_code, screening_tier, screening_status, initiated_at, cleared_at, access_state
FROM `redwood-hr.prod.contractor_screening`
WHERE initiated_at BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31';
```

screening-bot: Automated check: contractor_screening export scheduled weekly. Next run: 2026-07-06 02:00 UTC.

Jordan (Hiring Ops): Good. Can we also export hiring_manager and offer_ts so hiring managers can be nudged if checks are overdue?

Sam (People Ops): Yes will add hiring_manager and offer_ts columns. We will also add an SLA_alert boolean when screening has been pending >72h.

Marta (Legal): I'll deliver restricted-country list and suggested wording for opt-out/appeal procedures by Wed. Also recommend we require contractor e-sign ack for screening consent.

Devon (Security): For onboarding: SRE will wait for access_state=cleared before provisioning service accounts. We'll coordinate the webhook schema. Can People Ops add webhook docs?

Sam (People Ops): I'll add webhook spec to the ops README and include an example payload. Also we'll require contractor e-sign within 7 days of offer or HR will rescind.

i18n-team: We can translate the consent language and recruiter emails; need final copy freeze. Typical turnaround: 4 business days for EN->FR/DE/ES. Please mark placeholders like {candidate_name} and {policy_link}.

Jordan (Hiring Ops): Action items: 1) Hiring Ops to validate export format with SRE by Fri. 2) Legal to provide restricted-country list by Wed. 3) Security to confirm webhook schema. 4) People Ops to update handbook + publish consent flow and run pilot for next month.

Sam (People Ops): Will publish draft with e-sign flow and run pilot for July contractors. I'll post the export sample and webhook spec in this thread when ready. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
